requirements.requirement: The system must produce identical composite scores for the same clinical trial input across repeated executions.
The system must validate that composite scores change deterministically when a single measure value is modified.
The system must verify that all configured measure weights are applied exactly as defined in the scoring schema.
The system must confirm that the sum of weighted measures equals the final composite score within an acceptable precision tolerance.
The system must validate normalization logic by ensuring all individual measure scores fall within the defined normalized range.
The system must successfully compute scores for clinical trial records containing all required measures (happy path).
The system must integrate with clinical_trials_service outputs and produce a scored result for each returned trial.
The system must validate that the scoring engine preserves trial identifiers and core metadata from clinical_trials_service in the output.
The system must confirm that contributing measure breakdowns are included alongside the composite score in test outputs.
The system must handle missing optional measures by applying default or fallback logic without failing (exception path).
The system must handle completely missing required measures by returning a controlled failure or null score response (exception path).
The system must validate that scores remain within the defined global score bounds (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100).
The system must verify that different clinical trials with distinct measure inputs produce non-identical composite scores.
The system must validate that scoring results are consistent when invoked through both direct scoring logic and via evaluate_care_facade integration.
